channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Welcoming his first child, Redza Rosli reflects on family, faith and duty
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Actor Redza Rosli has expressed deep gratitude following the arrival of his first child, describing the newborn as both a blessing and a profound responsibility that has transformed his world.

item.title: UPSI book wins Asean literary award, highlights Malay intellectual thought
item.description: TANJUNG MALIM: A Universiti Pendidikan Sultan Idris (UPSI) publication, "Worldview and Hegemoni Sastera Melayu", has received international recognition after winning an award in an Asean book competition

item.title: National basketball teams get players from Nigeria, Congo and US
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia has powered up its national teams with three naturalised players — from Nigeria, Congo and the United States.

item.title: Police sergeant charged with RM2,500 graft over alleged urine test bribe
item.description: BUTTERWORTH: A police sergeant pleaded not guilty after being charged at the Sessions Court with graft of RM2,500.

item.title: Healthcare reform underway as costs rise, public hospitals strain: Health Minister
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The government is pressing ahead with a comprehensive healthcare reform to address rising medical costs, growing insurance dropouts and mounting pressure on public hospitals, Health Minister Datuk Seri Dr Dzulkefly Ahmad said.

item.title: Police track down man seen holding parang in viral clip
item.description: IPOH: Police here have identified the man seen holding a parang and making an obscene gesture in a viral video.

item.title: Malaysia equities set for 2026 gains amid stronger ringgit, foreign inflows
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia’s equity market is expected to make further gains this year, supported by a healthy domestic economy, positive corporate earnings, and pent-up foreign fund inflows.

item.title: Sepang test: Alex Marquez still fastest, Yamaha back on track on final day
item.description: SEPANG: Alex Marquez, who topped the afternoon session yesterday (Feb 5), again set the pace in the morning session on the final day of official MotoGP testing here today.

item.title: Malaysia's services producer price index up 1pct in Q4: Statistics Department
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia's Services Producer Price Index (SPPI) rose one per cent in the fourth quarter (4Q) of 2025, maintaining the same rate of increase for the third consecutive quarter, said the Statistics Department today.

item.title: Indira Gandhi points to ex-husband's BUDI95, SARA aid records in appeal over missing daughter
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: Kindergarten teacher M. Indira Gandhi today applied to adduce fresh evidence at the Court of Appeal in relation to the whereabouts of her former husband, K. Pathmanathan.
